You're approaching a Point of No Return. Don't get into Songbird's van unless you're locked and loaded.
After the events of Q304 V is supposed to wait for a call from Songbird.
Songbird dies if player shows up at the meeting spot, receives the second holocall and leaves the location instead of heading to the van.

Placeholder - ultimately the intention is to have V enter through the back, lean/hide behind the front seats and observe the area through the front shield. The first part of their conversation with Songbird will also take place in the back of the van - from there they'll move to the front seats and drive to the spaceport.

Player can either use an airhypo to resuscitate Songbird or interact with the nearby screen - and complete her reboot (could be gated by a skillcheck). If player doesn't pick either of the options - Songbird dies.

A holocall from REED pops up on HUD and on the autopilot monitoring screen (that V's plugged into).                                                                                                                 Player can either pick it up or ignore it.

An autopilot alert pops up on the screen V was supposed to monitor.                                                                                                       Player can either react or not.
Holocall from Reed will trigger either after a set amount of time (for now - 2h) or when player reaches the general vicinity of Song's van.
V opted to hand over So Mi's coordinates - FIA shows up in the van alley and picks her up. Q306 ends (question remains, will we have an epilogue after this scenario).
